subject.title: [Feature]: support SecretRef for channel phone numbers as it's Personal Identifiable Information (PII)

question: Should OpenClaw treat channel phone numbers and allowlists as SecretRef-capable sensitive identifiers across bundled messaging and telephony plugins, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73822 as the canonical implementation path?
rationale: This changes security-sensitive config semantics and runtime access-control inputs across several plugins, so maintainer intent is needed before accepting or replacing the linked PR.

options.title: Review linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use the existing linked PR as the implementation path, requiring security/compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the scope first
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that starts with the highest-risk channels and leaves the rest tracked separately.

options.title: Defer phone identifiers
options.body: Keep only credential SecretRefs for now and document phone-number plaintext tradeoffs until the product boundary is clearer.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Use the existing linked PR as the implementation path, requiring security/compatibility proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest overlap between the issue discussion, security-sensitive config policy, WhatsApp schema history, and voice-call config history.
